tool_args.rationale: The low-s_grad open-branch observation does not settle the apparent interaction/nonlinearity in the outputs. The available fine trajectory batch is the remaining relevant measurement for improving identifiability before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a smooth response model from the six current rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations vary mainly in u_now and s_grad, so competing interaction and branch models remain underidentified; there is no fresh confirmation basis for the requested tolerance.
An auxiliary nuisance reading would not resolve the response-law ambiguity and is explicitly not worth buying.
That probe has already produced a low-s_grad observation; another broad trajectory batch is more likely to add discriminating coverage.
